title: The Treasures of the Argonauts/Quotes
summary:
"Are you saying I have commitment issues?"
— Lok Lambert to Sophie Casterwill

"He's from the Organization, Dante. You can't trust any of them."
— Zhalia Moon to Dante Vale, about Grier

"You are my minion, you idiot!"
— DeFoe to Grier

"Sometimes honor can be found where you least expect it."
— Dante Vale to the rest of the Huntik team

"Zhalia, despite what Sophie says, I know that by the end of the day, I can trust you."
— Dante Vale to Zhalia Moon
